8.11.1. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.track.buildTrackCircuitPath¶

iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.track.buildTrackCircuitPath(path, railyard, TCTypes=None, allowFork=False)¶

Function returning the “shifted path” of a given path.

The shift M{pS} of a path M{p} is obtained from M{p} as follows:
  • The starting point of M{p} is moved forward until it touches the beginning of a track circuit, i.e. the segment after the starting point of M{pS} will be contained in a track circuit beginning at the starting point of M{pS}, given that the length of M{pS} is not zero (in which case None is returned). Note that this may move the starting point over segments not contained in track circuits.
  • If the last segment of M{p} is contained in a track circuit, the end point of M{p} is moved forward in the same way as the starting point of M{p}. In this process, the search forward might fork (typically over a switch). This gives an error if the parameter allowFork is False (the default). If allowFork is True, then the shifted path is forked along the lowest index.
  • If the last segment of M{p} is _not_ contained in a track circuit, the end point of M{p} is instead moved in the other direction, towards the beginning of the path, until a track circuit boundary is reached.

Thus M{pS} will either be None (if M{p} does not have any “internal” track circuits) or it will have its first and last segment contained in some track circuit(s).

Also note that it is required that every track segment encountered is contained in at most one track circuit (as defined by the argument TCTypes).

Parameters:
  • path (IPath) – The base path which the shifted path is calculated with respect to.
  • railyard (IRailyard) – The railyard were the shifted path is calculated (the path must be a path in the graph of railyard, but it does not have to be registered there).
  • TCTypes (Iterable(str) | str | none) – The user types that denote track circuits (subtypes of the base type Area). Note that a string argument will be, interpreted as a 1-tuple, not as a character-iterable. An argument of None will be interpreted as “no restriction”, i.e. the same as if TCTypes is the set of all user subtypes of base type Area.
  • allowFork (bool) – If True, then forking of the shifted end point is allowed.
Return type:

IPath | none
Returns:

The shifted path, None if the shifted path has length 0.
